subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should this combined issue remain open as the coordinating item for read-only exec warning plus lastToolError/payloadCount=0 fallback behavior, or should maintainers split it into the open placeholder and replay-unsafe incomplete-turn canonical threads?
rationale: The placeholder symptom is already covered by open canonical issue work, but the source still shows a distinct exec warning/fallback policy choice that automation should not decide by line-editing one branch.

options.title: Keep as coordination issue
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define the no-reply tool-error contract and then close or split the duplicate placeholder pieces with links to the canonical issues.

options.title: Split into canonical issues
options.body: Move the placeholder evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96857 and the payloadless incomplete-turn evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657, then close this issue only if the exec-warning branch is explicitly covered.

options.title: Queue a narrow fix
options.body: Approve a focused repair that changes warning/fallback behavior with tests for read-only exec-like failures and zero-payload lastToolError turns, accepting the product decision now.

recommendation.title: Keep as coordination issue
